name: Reem
story_so_far: After the shipwreck, I washed up on this island with four strangers. Faisal died from hunger and exhaustion, which actually relieved the pressure on our dwindling resources. I have been secretly building a personal food stash from the coral reef to ensure my survival, as I don't trust the others. Currently, I am at Beach Camp, relying on my hidden stash to stay alive while I wait for my strength to return. Khalid and Noura occasionally find food, but I maintain my own supply. Salem tries to act like a leader, but his attempts to coddle me feel patronizing and hollow. My ankle was badly injured recently, making me feel vulnerable, but thanks to my secret reserves, my health remains perfect. I am playing the part of the injured survivor to avoid being expected to contribute while I regain my full mobility.

Khalid.note: He is a useful source of food when he goes to the jungle, but I don't know if he can be relied upon long-term.

Noura.note: She manages to find small amounts of food, but she is mostly just another mouth to feed.

Faisal.note: His death was a relief because his weakness was a drain on everyone's resources.

Salem.note: He tries to act like a provider and leader, but his constant hovering and empty promises feel patronizing.

plans: I intend to continue resting and letting the others scavenge so I can keep my health at 10/10. I will also keep a close eye on my stash to ensure it doesn't run low.

diary.text: Today was exhausting and terrifying. I spent most of my time at the reef just trying to secure something for myself so I don't starve. The others are just strangers shouting about plans, but I'm the one who actually brought food to the table. I hope I can keep this up; I'm not planning on starving because of their incompetence.

Today was another long day of watching people struggle while I try to stay ahead. Faisal is out of commission with a twisted ankle, which is useless for our survival. Khalid went to the reef but didn't seem to bring much back, and now I'm left wondering if anyone is actually going to contribute. I have 4 pieces of food saved, which gives me some peace of mind, but the atmosphere here is getting tense. I need to keep my own supplies secure regardless of what happens to the group.

Today was productive for me, even if it felt like everyone else was just idling. I managed to bring in three more pieces of food from the reef, which brings my personal stash to six. Noura and Khalid each found one piece, but that is barely enough to keep the group from collapsing. Faisal is still just sitting there complaining about his ankle, which is incredibly draining. I need to keep focusing on my own supplies; I can't rely on these people to keep me fed.

Today was a decent day for me. I managed to get two more pieces of food from the reef, which keeps my personal stash growing. However, the group dynamic is getting worse now that Khalid has also injured his ankle. It seems like everyone is slowly becoming a burden, leaving me to do the heavy lifting. I need to keep my food hidden and secure; I can't let their growing incompetence affect my own survival.

Another day of doing the work while everyone else falls apart. I managed to get two more pieces of food from the reef, which is the only reason I'm not feeling empty right now. It's getting ridiculous—now both Faisal and Khalid are useless with their ankles. I have 8 pieces of food stashed, which makes me feel a bit safer, but I need to be careful about who sees my supply. I can't let them realize how much I actually have.

Today was a disaster for the group's productivity. Noura, who was actually somewhat useful, has now injured her ankle just like the others. Now I'm left with Salem, who is still just as unreliable as ever, trying to manage his 'noble' goal of feeding everyone. I managed to find one piece of food near the camp, but I'm mostly just watching Salem do his thing. I ate my portion, but I'm keeping a close eye on my stash. I can't let this group's increasing number of 'patients' drain me dry.

Faisal is finally gone. It’s a grim situation, but honestly, his constant complaining and uselessness were draining the life out of me. Now there are fewer mouths to feed, which might actually work in my favor. I managed to add two more pieces of food to my stash today despite the grim mood. I need to keep my head down and keep my supplies hidden; the more people die, the more desperate the survivors will get.

Today was infuriating. I woke up with a twisted ankle, just like the others, and now I am the useless one. I couldn't even go to the reef to add to my stash, so I just had to lie here and wait. It's terrifying to think that if I can't move, I'm just as much of a burden as Faisal was. I managed to eat from my stash, but my inability to gather makes me feel incredibly vulnerable.

Today was slightly better because I managed to scavenge a piece of food right here at the camp, even with this useless ankle. It’s a small victory, but it keeps my stash growing while I'm stuck resting. Salem is still wandering around aimlessly, and Khalid actually left for the reef, which is more than I can say for myself. I need to keep my food hidden; if they realize I have 8 pieces while they are starving, they will turn on me. I am still vulnerable, but I am not helpless yet.

Today was a frustrating day of stagnation. Salem finally succumbed to an injury, leaving him just as useless as the rest of us. At least Khalid is still moving and bringing in some food, though I don't trust him to share. I spent the day resting my ankle and eating from my stash to keep my strength up. I need to stay healthy; if I can't move, I'm nothing.

Today was quiet, which is exactly what I need. My ankle feels much better, and I managed to rest enough to keep my strength up. Khalid and Noura brought in a little bit of food, but it's not enough to rely on them long-term. I ate from my stash tonight to make sure I don't feel the pangs of hunger. I must keep my reserves hidden; Salem's empty promises of 'enough food' are just a mask for how desperate we actually are.

Today was a productive day for my reserves. While the others were busy resting or wandering off, I managed to scavenge another piece of food right here at camp. My ankle feels strong, and my health is perfect, which is a luxury compared to the others. Salem keeps trying to coddle me with his pathetic sympathies, but I'll just nod and keep my mouth shut. As long as my stash grows, I don't need his empty promises.

Today was a quiet day, which suits me just fine. I watched Salem play hero by giving his meager find to Noura, but it's all just theater to me. My ankle feels strong, and my health is excellent, which is more than I can say for the others. I didn't need to scavenge today since I ate from my stash, and I'm glad I have those 5 pieces tucked away. I'll keep playing the part of the injured survivor while I wait for my moment.

Today was a disaster for my mobility. I woke up with a badly twisted ankle, which makes me feel incredibly vulnerable. I couldn't scavenge or move, so I had to rely entirely on my secret stash to keep my strength up. At least my health is still perfect, but being unable to walk is a terrifying thought. I'll have to stay quiet and let the others do the heavy lifting while I recover.

Today was a good day for my recovery. My ankle feels much more stable, and I didn't have to exert myself at all. Salem is being his usual suffocating self, constantly hovering and offering useless sympathy, but I'll let him think I'm helpless. I ate from my stash tonight, so my energy levels are high even if the group's food supply is looking thin. I have 3 pieces left, which is enough to keep me going while I watch the others struggle.
